player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CmdCorranH''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
description: My anti WYS deck that can beat up on most other decks as well. Big drains for me and small drains for my opponent. Uses Red & Green (cannons) cards to beat up on the opponent.
cards: There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement
posted: There is No Try/Oppressive Enforcement
posted: SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons X 3
posted: Presence of the Force x2
posted: All Power To Weapons X 3
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(8)': Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, Endor, Endor: Landing Platform, Endor: Bunker, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Power Of The Hutt, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Endor', 'Endor DB' and 'Endor Bunker' dested the Dark Endor printings (system, Landing Platform docking bay, Bunker) the objective deploys; 'Kashyyk' dested Kashyyyk (Dark); Sullust dested the Dark Death Star II system.
Posted 'Hell To Pay' dested There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Ghhhk/Rebel' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Zuckess in MH' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
The Effects header says 10 but 9 Effects are listed; the list totals 60 as posted.
The strategy mentions grabbers x3, Undercover spies, Omni Box, Secret Plans and Lateral Damage, none of which are in the list.
Same author's later version is 14691 (8 TIE Interceptors, Dengar In Punishing One instead of Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, plus Well Guarded); the lists differ, so this is not a repost.
